People: A male companion in a white hoodie walks directly ahead; two other men walk further ahead. Phone: Held in XXX view, screen off. World text: '此门应常闭，请刷卡进入 / 切勿私自将门反扣常开！ / 视频监控中', 'EXIT 出口'. segments.action: I walk along the parking garage driving lane behind my companion.

segments.action: I raise my smartphone with both hands and type 'kfc' into the WeChat search box.

segments.speech: 三四个，我们来一个，再来两个。不点。KFC。

segments.action: I dismiss Control Center and view the WeChat search dropdown suggestions for KFC.

segments.action: I walk forward along the lane in an underground parking garage while looking at my phone screen as the KFC mini-program loads.

Physical space: An underground parking garage with a smooth grey concrete/epoxy floor marked with yellow lines, white directional arrows, and yellow-and-black speed bumps. The concrete walls and pillars are painted white on top and light blue/teal below, featuring zone 'A' pillar markings. Overhead fluorescent tube fixtures provide artificial lighting along the drive lane. Two men in shorts and t-shirts walk ahead of me in the distance.

segments.action: I say '我操，KFC小程序怎么只有二点二星了？' while looking at the loaded KFC mini-program home screen and tapping the '开始点餐' button.

segments.speech: 我操，KFC小程序怎么只有二点二星了？
segments.details: My right thumb presses the red '开始点餐 Order Now' button on the screen.

segments.action: I continue walking as the KFC store menu for '中科餐厅' loads on my phone screen.

segments.details: I keep walking while glancing at the top of the menu page.

segments.action: I inspect the '请选择取餐方式' pop-up modal on my phone screen while walking.
segments.environment: A modal dialog titled '请选择取餐方式' pops up from the bottom of the screen showing three options: '堂食' (店内就餐), '外带' (到店自提), and '开车速取' (沿街取餐), along with a red '确认' confirmation button. No delivery option is present.
segments.details: My gaze moves across the three pickup method options (堂食, 外带, 开车速取) and notes the absence of delivery.

segments.action: I close the modal, look at the menu items, and say '哎，没有快递，我操！'.
segments.environment: The pickup selection modal is closed, displaying the menu list with items including '自选炸鸡三兄弟(任选3桶) 69.9元', '狂欢畅选半价桶 39.9元', and '夏日黄金鸡块双拼 20元'. The companions ahead walk towards the corridor bend.

segments.details: I type 'meituan' with both thumbs and tap directly on the suggested yellow Meituan app icon.

segments.environment: Physical space: A spacious, brightly illuminated indoor commercial gym. The ceiling is painted matte dark charcoal with exposed ductwork, longitudinal warm-white LED strip light bars, and spotlights. Light gray smooth rubber athletic flooring covers the walkway, while black speckled rubber mats underlie the equipment zone. A full-length wall mirror on the left reflects rows of gym machines and ceiling lights. Objects: Directly ahead stands a commercial multi-station cable crossover/functional trainer by SHUA (舒华), constructed from dark gray tubular steel frames with curved overhead pull-up bars, dual vertical pulley columns with laser-etched height markings, dark gray protective weight shrouds with 'SHUA' branding, and a central eye-level exercise instruction placard. A horizontal accessory rack bar with hooks sits below the placard. To the left foreground is a black vinyl flat workout bench. In the middle-ground to the left, a linear row of selectorized strength machines (chest press, seated row, leg extension) with gray shrouds and yellow informational placards extends along the floor. In front of me stands a companion wearing a white hooded long-sleeve athletic shirt and beige trousers. Screen content: No electronic digital screens are active; a smartphone rests on the seat of a leg machine in the middle left background. World text: 'SHUA', 'SHUA 舒华', column index numbers (14, 16, 18, 20, 22), and '舒华体育股份有限公司' printed on machine labels. Ambient audio: Low hum of gym air conditioning and distant faint metallic gym sounds.

建议 · 提升积极体验
卡住超过 15 分钟就别在电脑上硬刚了，拿张 A4 纸 + 马克笔，先用手画出最丑版本的架构草图，把逻辑关系理清楚就行，草图拍照丢给 AI 工具（比如直接描述给 Claude）帮你出第一版矢量图，你再微调。
预测你 22:00 左右会卡在架构图上，越画越烦躁，焦虑和疲劳同时飙升
你做作业时戴耳机进入心流状态能到9分，但前提是思路清晰——纸笔能帮你把「画图」和「理结构」拆开，降低同时处理的认知负荷

秦医生和 MSK 的睡眠指南都提到：睡前 30 分钟断屏 + 适度的体温变化能促进褪黑素分泌，你的情绪数据库里「微风看红云」得了 9 分，说明身体感官体验对你的放松效果很强
web_arch 不是叫你「少看手机」这种空话，而是给了物理隔离手机的具体方案 + 替代性感官活动
